test_case.test_name: Exact 1800-second all-GPU CoralGEMM power, thermal and availability validation
test_case.purpose: Drive all mapped GPUs concurrently with the exact FP64 CoralGEMM stimulus for 1800 seconds and prove per-GPU power, thermal and availability plus system PSU behavior remain safe and fault-free.
required_package: Pinned AMD-HPC CoralGemm commit/checksum, Release build provenance and compatible ROCm/rocBLAS/hipBLAS/hipBLASLt/rocRAND/hipRAND stack
Stable visible-GPU UUID/BDF/serial map and verified command-to-all-device scope
Per-GPU board-power telemetry plus BMC PSU/feed sensor map, units, sample interval and timestamp correlation
Approved 1000-W per-GPU ceiling, platform thermal/throttle/RAS limits, PSU/cooling capacity, OOB access and recovery
test_case.test_command: Record artifact/build/stack hashes, visible GPU identity/order and all power-sensor units. Start high-rate per-GPU power/temperature/clock/throttle/RAS monitoring and BMC PSU/feed sampling before launch. Run the pinned Release binary exactly once as `./gemm R_64F R_64F R_64F R_64F OP_N OP_T 8640 8640 8640 8640 8640 8640 36 1800 strided`, preserving stdout/stderr and actual status. Continue synchronized GPU, dmesg, RAS and BMC/PSU capture through completion and post-health inventory.
test_case.expected_result: The binary drives every mapped visible GPU for the complete 1800 seconds and exits successfully. Each GPU remains online and below or equal to the source 1000-W per-GPU ceiling and approved thermal boundary with no unexpected throttle; pre-trigger BMC PSU traces capture initial and sustained maxima without shutdown, hang, reset, RAS/dmesg or other platform failure.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires exact command/artifact evidence, all-GPU coverage for 1800 seconds, successful process status, complete per-GPU power/thermal/health traces, each GPU <=1000 W, independently reported PSU maxima and clean kernel/RAS/BMC/post-health evidence. Chassis PSU power divided by GPU count, a shortened run, missing GPU or absent initial-spike window cannot pass.
safety_gate: Approve exact artifact/stack and review visible-device scope before load
Verify per-GPU and PSU sensor mappings, sample rate, PSU/feed/cooling headroom and independent BMC/OOB access
Begin monitoring before launch and preserve baseline logs; do not clear historical evidence
Abort on >1000 W per GPU, thermal/power limit, unexpected throttle, GPU offline/reset, RAS/dmesg fault, hang or management loss; never auto-retry
expected_evidence: CoralGemm commit/build/stack provenance and exact command/environment
Visible GPU UUID/BDF map and GPU/BMC PSU sensor map with units
Complete 1800-second stdout/stderr and actual process status
Pre-trigger through post-run per-GPU power/thermal/clock/throttle/RAS traces and BMC PSU/feed maxima
Kernel/BMC event delta, post-health inventory and signed engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: On any threshold or platform fault, terminate CoralGemm, preserve first-failure and pre-trigger evidence, verify every GPU plus PSU/cooling and BMC health, restore only approved temporary build/environment changes and escalate. Do not power-cycle or rerun automatically.
